Definitely one of my favorites - not that it matters much, I love all of the Ghibli films that I've seen.

We see Miyazaki's theme of "Man vs. Nature" in this film, and it's perhaps the most "in your face" of the bunch, contested only by Princess Mononoke.

The soundtrack is phenomenal, which is to be expected of Joe Hisaishi.

Visuals are great as always. The larger than life feel they have to them with all of the spreading vistas and viewscapes, the sheer size of the Ohms as well as the airship seen early on.

This is also where we first meet the little yellow striped fox thing! Adorable little animal, feisty little thing. They make an appearance in Laputa as well, though I'm not sure of any other films.

Interesting to note about Nausicaa - it was before Ghibli had been founded, so it is technically not a Ghibli film, though it is counted as one by most people.

Excellent movie.

If you liked Nausicaa, you should also check out Origins: Spirits of the Past. Same "Man vs. Nature" theme with the whole "Guy trying to master nature" thing going on, great soundtrack, great visuals. Give it a shot.
